full_prompt_en: A mid-century pulp-adventure cover painting places a confident aviation adventurer close to the viewer in front of a silver aircraft. She wears a dark blue helmet, fitted teal-green flight suit, broad belt, and light gloves. One hand rests on her hip while the other holds a compact dark object at her side; her head turns left with a cool, alert expression. Behind her, a soldier in an ocher uniform and green helmet looks outward, holding a small weapon in a defensive pose. The pale metal nose and fuselage of the aircraft angle behind them, partly enclosed by a shadowy hangar opening and weathered pale masonry at the right. The main figure dominates the composition from upper head to lower edge, with the smaller soldier creating depth and narrative urgency. Strong graphic shapes make the scene instantly legible: teal clothing against cream aircraft, dark blue helmet against charcoal background, and small red lips and cheeks as warm focal notes. The painting is realistic enough to show fabric seams, leather gloves, metal panel lines, and reflected highlights, but brushwork remains vigorous and visible, especially in shadowed stone and clothing folds. Light enters from the upper left, striking the face, helmet, sleeve, and aircraft edge; deep brown-black shadow surrounds the group and sharpens their silhouettes. Cream and gray metal planes keep the right side open despite the close framing. The result feels cinematic and suspenseful, with the polished confidence and heightened color of a classic illustrated magazine cover.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅世纪中叶通俗冒险封面画把一名自信的航空冒险者放在观者近前的银色飞机前。她戴深蓝头盔，穿合身青绿飞行服、宽腰带和浅手套。一只手叉腰，另一只在身侧握着紧凑深色物件；头转向左侧，神情冷静警醒。她身后，一名赭黄制服与绿头盔的士兵向外望，以防备姿势握小型武器。飞机浅色金属机首和机身在身后斜伸，部分被暗机库开口与右侧风化浅色砌体围住。主角从上方头顶到下缘主宰构图，较小士兵建立深度与叙事紧迫感。强图形形状使场景立刻可读：青绿衣服对奶油飞机，深蓝头盔对炭色背景，细小红唇和脸颊作暖焦点。画面足够写实，可见布缝、皮手套、金属板线与反射高光，但笔触仍强劲可见，尤其在阴影石面与衣褶中。光从左上进入，击中脸、头盔、袖与机身边；深褐黑影围住群组，强化剪影。奶油与灰金属面让右侧虽紧裁仍显开放。整体电影感且悬疑，具有经典插画杂志封面的光洁自信与强化配色。
style_prompt_en: Mid-century pulp-cover painting combines bold readable silhouettes, polished focal modeling, and vigorous visible brushwork. Large teal and cream planes oppose navy and charcoal masses, with ocher and small scarlet accents giving warmth. Precise highlights and fine lines describe selected hard and soft materials, while shadowed peripheries break into looser strokes and grain. Directional light from high to one side picks out rounded upper surfaces and sharp metal-like edges, leaving a deep dark frame around the focal cluster. A large near shape overlaps a smaller secondary form and a pale diagonal backdrop, creating immediate depth within tight cropping. Edges remain crisp at the dramatic center but roughen in weathered surroundings. The composition has suspenseful, cinematic energy, using a few strong color blocks and a compact narrative hierarchy rather than exhaustive background detail.
style_prompt_zh: 世纪中叶通俗封面画结合大胆可读剪影、光洁焦点塑形与强劲可见笔触。大青绿和奶油平面对位海军蓝与炭色体量，赭与细小猩红重点带来暖意。精确高光和细线描述精选硬软材料，阴影外围则裂成更松笔痕和颗粒。高处单侧定向光拣出圆浑上表面和尖锐金属般边，焦点簇群周围留下深暗框架。巨大近形叠住较小次形与浅色斜背景，在紧裁切中即时建立深度。戏剧中心边缘清楚，风化环境里变粗。构图有悬疑电影能量，依靠少数强色块和紧凑叙事层级，而非穷尽背景细节。
theme_en: A helmeted aviation adventurer stands before a silver aircraft with a tense companion behind
theme_zh: 戴飞行头盔的冒险者立于银色飞机前，身后同伴神情紧张
name: Gray Morrow
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
